I see, so they sell it at drugstores!
I'll buy the next bottle myself, I'm getting used to doing the care routine now!

Nail... ah, I know that!
You paint it on your nails, right?! Is this part of training too?!
(It's okay, this'll work. With this—)

I'm counting on you, Trainer!!
I swear!! I'm gonna win this!

Huh, why are you thanking me, Trainer?!
I'm the one who should be saying thank you, always!!

Got it!! Honestly, a big part of me really
wants to train like crazy, but...!!

Oh, I almost forgot! That nail oil you gave me
is almost all gone! Where do they sell that stuff?

Strengthening my hooves is part of training too!!
I'll make sure to follow your instructions to the letter!!

Tr-Trainer!
What's with all these fancy cosmetics?!

Yet Bamboo Memory placed complete trust in someone she had only just met.
That was a testament to her honesty and—
Huh?! A-Are you sure?! But we only just met the other day!!

The reason Bamboo Memory, with her weak hooves, mainly ran on dirt
was because dirt yielded lower speeds and exerted less impact on her legs.
I can race Oguri-senpai!!

So please! Teach me how to do hoof care!
I want to be able to do it myself too!

All I gotta do is believe. Once I believe in something, I never back down!
That's what my dad taught me, too!!

...! Then I gotta give it everything I've got!!
Wait, so that means I really CAN go all out, right?!

Bamboo Memory's stride was light. Compared to when
she first started training on turf, her times had improved dramatically.

...Honestly, I had considered the possibility that she might quit halfway through.
Keeping up with unglamorous, steady training is surprisingly difficult.

I gave a deep nod.
I intended to provide her with thorough, impeccable care to make sure of it.
Yeah. Honestly, I'm getting impatient!

But we made a promise, right? That you'd get me ready to fight on turf.
If you're saying so, Trainer—

Conversely, turf is easier to run on and makes it easier to build speed,
but compared to dirt, the momentum carries further and the impact on the legs is much greater.

Apply oil to moisturize, and protect the hooves with a coating agent. Nail care
is a perfectly legitimate form of training to get in peak condition!

Compete on turf... 
Enough to properly take on Oguri-senpai?

To be honest, a part of me
really just wants to run a bit more, though...

I guess we're going with the "train while taking care of the hooves!"
kind of approach after all, right?

The next day, I visited the academy grounds earlier than usual once again.
This time it wasn't by coincidence, but by waking up early with a clear purpose.

All right, got it! Ah, but to be honest,
I haven't really been used to doing that kind of thing before.

Yes, sir! It really keeps the feel of my dad's routine too!!
It gets me totally fired up!!

Of course, meticulous care must be maintained going forward.
It didn't mean all concerns regarding her legs were gone, but—

! The new "Passionate Training" routine
you put together feels amazing too, Trainer!

Burn on, Passionate Training!! Part twenty!!
Blazing Acceleration! Falcon Cutback Exercise!! —Completed, sir!!

That's right, endurance is also Passionate Training!!
Alright, time to endure with all the heat and power I've got~~!!

Therefore, we can't suddenly jump into high-load training.
We should progress gradually, placing emphasis on hoof care.

Her passion for her dream was simply that steadfast.
It drove the point home for me once again.

Yes, sir!!
—Hehe. Dad used to say something similar.

Huh, Trainer!?
What's up, did you wake up early again?

On another day—Bamboo Memory was quietly watching
the other Umamusume working hard in their training.

After school.
I decided to hold a strategy meeting together with Bamboo Memory.
On another day—
Hah... hah... hah... hah...!

A few more days after that—around the time Bamboo Memory
unsealed her second bottle of nail oil.

Hmm, maybe I shouldn't run on turf today.
I really want to train just a bit more, though.

Seeing how the continuous care and training had borne fruit
in her current condition, I couldn't help but feel immense potential...!
Another day—
